note: Two columns on the page image. Left column: Superintendent's office (heading line 2; central-office, the page school), High School administration (headings 17-18 '(Lunenburg High School)'), Turkey Hill (41-42), Passios (52-53). Right column: Guidance Department (heading line 2, no school printed: district-wide) and Special Needs Department (heading line 22) and Special Needs Clerical (62-63). Within Special Needs a school was set only where the person's own position text names one: Aubuchon 'High School Resource Room' -> high; Hughes 'Middle School Core' -> turkey-hill; Irwin 'Elementary Resource Room' -> passios; Murray '(Primary School Resource Room)' -> primary; Lawrence '(Office: Middle School)' -> turkey-hill (printed office location). Carey, Howard (SPED Administrator), Maki, Petrowicz, St. Jean, Wilson name no school -> district-wide. Counselors list grade bands only (district-wide). Column assignment of one-name lines checked on the image (Davenport line 7, Dubzinski 10, Falcone 12, Light 15, Mills 18 and Marybarbara Hughes 37 are right column). Lines carrying only start dates, years of service, hours, FTE or notes of replacement/resignation (e.g. Quirk 'RESIGNED' line 36, Ruggles 'RETIRED' line 63) are ignored; Ruggles and Quirk remain entries as printed staff. Line 1 is the page title and line 69 the page number: ignored. Line 28 'it' is a stray mark.
